items.title: New Trump tariffs 'make it harder for Australian businesses to compete'
items.description: The Business Council of Australia says a new tariff will make it harder for Australian businesses to compete in the US and could reduce investment.

items.title: Why did Trump slap a 12.5pc tariff on Australian imports?
items.description: The tariffs are supposed to combat forced labour, but one expert says the US president was just looking for another legal way to tax foreign imports.

items.title: Defence minister confirms former senior naval officer faces court martial
items.description: A former senior naval officer will face charges in a military trial set down for up to six weeks from September 14 with the military court ordering their identity remain suppressed.

items.title: Live: Broken lane rope halts Aussie charge at Comm Games pool
items.description: It's officially day one of the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, with the the first medals of the Games up for grabs in the para powerlifting. Follow live.

items.title: Hundreds attend memorial for murdered mum Jana Armstrong
items.description: Jana Armstrong has been remembered as a beloved sister, loving mother and valued member of the Toowoomba community following her death two weeks ago.

items.title: Police officer shot while responding to call on the Fraser Coast
items.description: An emergency declaration has been made in Yengarie, west of Maryborough, under the Public Safety Preservation Act.

items.title: Reginald Chard, Australia's last surviving Kokoda veteran, dies at 102
items.description: Australia's last surviving Kokoda campaign veteran, Reginald James Chard OAM, has died aged 102.

items.title: Live: Storm shrug off sluggish start to punish Souths
items.description: After an awful start against South Sydney the Storm have rebounded well to take the lead before halftime. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Cats and Dees down to the wire, Dockers flex muscle against Eagles in derby
items.description: Melbourne hosts Geelong at the MCG with one club trying to stay in the top six and the other trying to break in, before the Dockers and Eagles meet in the Western Derby. Follow live.

items.title: Islanders sang hymns and kept vigil over body of teenager washed ashore
items.description: Twenty-seven people including families with young children went missing after two boats capsized in rough seas in Papua New Guinea's north-east on Saturday.

items.title: Four Corners withdraws episodes by sacked reporter
items.description: The ABC has withdrawn the Four Corners programs Meth Highway and Cocaine Nation by sacked reporter Mahmood Fazal due to concerns about accuracy.

items.title: New report reveals what triggered SA's catastrophic algal bloom crisis
items.description: A new report reveals what caused South Australia's most devastating algal bloom crisis — 18 months after it first appeared on the state's waters.

items.title: Socceroos star allegedly tests positive for cocaine after speeding
items.description: Police say they stopped the 22-year-old in a BMW Coupe about 1am today and allege he was travelling 109 kilometres per hour on the Anzac Bridge.

items.title: Rare eye disorder linked to Ozempic-like medications
items.description: The Therapeutic Goods Administration has issued a safety warning for a rare, but serious risk of vision impairment from taking GLP-1-based drugs such as Ozempic and Wegovy.

items.title: Adolescence creator tackles teen rehab very differently in The Good Boy
items.description: Emmy Award-winning Adolescence co-creator Stephen Graham tackles teen delinquency in a very different way in The Good Boy.

items.title: How and how often should you be cleaning out your freezer?
items.description: When it comes to kitchen cleaning, the freezer is the last frontier — a forgotten wasteland where food goes to die. But it's not hard to clean, and there are good reasons to do it.

items.title: Budjerah's debut album Gentleman has been a long time coming
items.description: Two-time ARIA Award-winning music artist Budjerah has just released his long-awaited debut album and announced an official tour.

items.title: Automakers in shock as China takes over
items.description: In June, a bulk carrier made an unprecedented delivery of EVs to Australia, sounding an ominous warning to the world's automakers.

items.title: Friends turned millionaires take tech company shares battle to court
items.description: The millionaire co-founder of an Australian video tech company behind some of Hollywood’s biggest blockbusters has told the Federal Court a decade of hostility by his fellow shareholders has unfairly barred him from selling his lucrative stake in the billion-dollar business.

items.title: Bondi attack had traumatic effect on MP's son, royal commission hears
items.description: Liberal MP Julian Leeser tells the Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion that his young son became too scared to attend Jewish events after last year's Bondi Beach terror attack.

items.title: Families of Sea World crash victims say 'lives changed forever'
items.description: After the powerful family statements had been read, Coroner Carol Lee teared up as she made her closing address to the court.

items.title: Have the AFL's rule changes worked? Not exactly
items.description: A raft of AFL rule changes for the 2026 season have either excited or horrified a range of fans — Cody Atkinson and Sean Lawson examine the changes and whether they have had the desired impact.

items.title: Warning spy laws too broad and could undermine democracy
items.description: A major review warns parts of Australia's national security laws could undermine democracy and press freedom.

items.title: AI has changed what criminals can do with your stolen Origin data
items.description: The theft of names, addresses and phone numbers may seem less serious than stolen bank details, but cyber experts say AI is changing what criminals can do with that information.

items.title: Woman allegedly makes antisemitic comments at Bondi attack site
items.description: A woman will face court after allegedly making antisemitic comments to a group including Jewish leaders and Sydney Swans players at the site of the Bondi terror attack.
